title: Recursive copy machine
statement: For each natural number $m$ and symbol alphabet $\Gamma$, define a deterministic Turing machine with two work tapes and the recursively specified state type. At $m=0$ it stays forever in its unique state without changing either work tape; at $m=1$ it copies from the first work tape to the second; for $m\ge 2$ it composes a copy, two tape-skipping machines, a recursive copy machine, and two returning machines, switching between them at their designated exit states.
